posts.text:
Today I co-chaired an open unclassified hearing with the House Intelligence Committee as part of the bipartisan 9/11 Commission Review twenty-five years after September 11th. 

WATCH my opening statements focused on the importance of strengthening our national security and intelligence agencies as we face modern day emerging threats.

Today marks the beginning of Passover. Chag Pesach Sameach to all those celebrating.

May this sacred season bring peace, joy, and renewal to you and your families. ✡️✨

Meet @ElsaJohnson, an American undergraduate junior at Stanford University who faced transnational repression (as well as her family!) from the Chinese Communist Party including online and physical surveillance on campus.  

Our universities have become soft targets for foreign espionage and gateways for our adversaries, and they need a serious wake-up call to address these significant national security threats.

Our U.S. universities are under siege from foreign espionage and national security threats that faculty and staff are turning a blind eye to.

Look no further than the University of Michigan where Chinese nationals connected to the school attempted to smuggle biological materials into the U.S.—or Stanford where a student just told me her university ignored Chinese espionage targeting her directly.

This should NEVER be happening on our kids’ college campuses. These are national security threats that demand accountability.

📺 WATCH:  

@kilmeade and I discuss Operation Epic Fury, Iranian terrorist regime relative professors actually teaching at many American colleges (!!), energy prices, and more! https://t.co/Dq99QNtD1W

TUNE IN to @kilmeade on @FoxNews @OneNationFNC at 10 pm ET where we discuss President Trump’s strong peace through strength national security, lowering energy prices, and foreign influence in our schools. 

Always sharp questions that cover many issues with Brian! https://t.co/tlNJw1yPbh

Tune in TONIGHT on @FoxNews at 10 pm ET where I join @kilmeade @OneNationFNC to discuss Operation Epic Fury, NY’s sky high taxes, and foreign influence in higher education.

Always love chatting with fellow NYer Brian - a mile a minute! Happy Sunday! https://t.co/EJZZY3FjDs

WATCH:

I joined @MariaBartiromo on @MariaWallStreet @FoxBusiness to discuss the failed economic policies of high taxed blue states like NY, malign foreign funding in American higher ed, Operation Epic Fury, & more! https://t.co/CDyrAfFmOn

This is the absolute correct decision by the Trump Administration to sue Harvard for failing to protect Jewish students.

This is after years of Congressional oversight work that I was proud to lead in holding Harvard accountable.

https://t.co/U75MVIQqpN

At today’s House Intelligence hearing, I shared my strong support for President Trump’s Operation Epic Fury and deep concerns about the inappropriate, antisemitic letter released by a former appointee. 

I thought it was important to ask @DNIGabbard about whether she shared those concerns about the letter.  

She said yes.   

WATCH👇

A deeply concerning new report from @HarvardJews Alumni Association highlights the plummeting of Jewish student admissions. 

“Harvard’s Jewish undergraduate enrollment stands at 7 percent today,
the lowest level recorded since before World War II and the lowest of any Ivy League institution with reliable data. That is roughly half what it was a decade ago, and less than a third of the 25 percent share Jewish students held for much of the latter twentieth century.
Among well-documented peer institutions, no school has seen a steeper recent-decade decline.”

In the hearing heard around the world from 2023, I pressed Harvard’s former president Gay on this matter and it was essentially shrugged off as you can see from this testimony. I strongly believe the antisemitism does not just impact students on campus at Harvard; it shapes admissions.

Worth a rewatch👇

“Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-NY) and Sen. Rick Scott (R-Fla.) demanded a “formal investigation” into a popular Chinese gadget maker, alleging its products pose “unacceptable risks to US national security.

The lawmakers flagged concerns about Anker — which sells “smart” home goods like security cameras through its Eufy brand, along with fast-charging batteries — in a letter to FCC Chairman Brendan Carr and Commerce Department Secretary Howard Lutnick.

They pointed out that Anker appeared to be targeting US military families with sales promotions, including a 20% discount on Eufy products for current and former service members and their spouses.”

Read more in @nypost👇

https://t.co/YL9BXar0No

#NY21 shares our prayers and deepest condolences to the families of the three brave servicemembers who lost their lives in service to our country in Operation Epic Fury. 

Our American servicemembers are heroes. Our nation must continue to pray for their safety and for their families.

As a senior Member of the House Armed Services Committee and the House Select Committee on Intelligence, I have always been consistent that Iran cannot have nuclear weapons capabilities that would threaten the national security of the United States. Iran is the world’s largest sponsor of terror and has targeted, killed, and wounded U.S. service members and civilians throughout the Middle East over the past decades including soldiers from the 10th Mountain Division. Additionally, the sick Iran regime controlled by the blood-thirsty ayatollah terrorists have destroyed a nation, continued to pursue nuclear weapons threatening America and all of humanity, slaughtered innocent Iranians, and shed blood across the Middle East including of Americans. 

I know President Trump has to make some of the most difficult decisions imaginable and there is no decision more serious that military action to protect our national security and American lives. 

God Bless our brave men and women in uniform. The American people are praying for your safety.

I agree with this wholeheartedly from @PressSec @karolineleavitt. And the American public agrees as it was a major highlight of the speech loved by real America outside of the incessant political commentating world.  

I thought it was masterfully handled how the Team was appropriately brought in as special guests for the portion of the speech highlighting their historic gold medal win. Well done by the @WhiteHouse and the athletes🥇

It was an honor to attend President Trump’s State of the Union where he highlighted the significant results that he has worked with Congress to deliver to the American people including the largest tax cut in history, a secure border, and a peace through strength national security agenda that supports our men and women in uniform. As always, the incredible stories that President Trump shared about the American heroes seated with the First Lady were inspiring. As Co-Chair of the Bipartisan Olympic Caucus and the Representative of Lake Placid where the famed Miracle on Ice took place 46 years ago, my favorite part was honoring the incredible Team USA hockey gold medalists - they are American icons and heroes. America couldn’t be prouder of them. They have continued the extraordinary legacy of the 1980 Miracle team and inspired a nation and a new generation.
I am beyond excited to attend President Trump’s historic State of the Union tomorrow honoring the incredible @TeamUSA @usahockey Olympic heroes!🥇🇺🇸 https://t.co/3U3Rky4X2I

Forty six years ago TODAY, Team USA shocked the world in Lake Placid in #NY21 when they outskated and out hustled the Soviet Union bringing the unforgettable Miracle on Ice. 

We are so PROUD of TEAM USA for their unbelievable win for America today. 

They never gave up!!!!🏒🥅
Sharing my wishes for a blessed and meaningful Ash Wednesday 🙏 ✝️ https://t.co/tnozkkpYTh

Happy Birthday to our Founding Father President George Washington! 

Happy President’s Day! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/rQT5uS0A2H

Sophia Kirby of Ray Brook #NY21   

Go @USA! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/Q0SFPCxDtH
#NY21 ! https://t.co/HyhK0jhX3r

The Olympics are incredibly meaningful to #NY21 due to the incredible history and community of Lake Placid. 

As Co-Chair of the bipartisan Congressional Olympic and Paralympic Caucus, I’m proud to work with my colleagues to advocate for our great American athletes who honor our country with their extraordinary talents.

Good luck to our dedicated @TeamUSA at this year's Milan @Olympics! 🥇🇺🇸

And a particular congratulations to #NY21's very own athletes:

✅Jonny Gustafson of Massena
✅ Sophia Kirkby of Ray Brook
✅ @sean_hollander of Lake Placid
✅ @FrantzTate of Lake Placid
✅ Kelsey O’Driscoll of Glens Falls
✅ Austin Florian, @ClarksonUniv grad
✅ Haley Winn, @ClarksonUniv grad
✅ Kaila Kuhn, lived and trained in Lake Placid
✅ Emily Fischnaller, now lives in Lake Placid

Go USA! 🇺🇸 #Olympics2026
